newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $1.1 bln for Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $1.1 bln for Tuesday.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Tuesday, July 15 were expected to total $1.1 billion in 48 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $767 million in 16 sales, with a $350 million Los Angeles Unified School District offering through BancAmerica Securities topping the list.
On the competitive side, 32 sales totaling $363 million are scheduled. A three-part $130.5 million Virginia HDA offering at 1130 EDT is the largest.
An additional eight sales totaling $173 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues Tuesday depending on market conditions.
